about_the_game:
Exploring the dream world is complicated… it's a world filled with both long lost friends, and nightmares. Equipped with your handy umbrella, you must steel your nerves to navigate and explore this treacherously surreal world— molded by remnants of your shaky past.

Master Tight, Tactical Combat

Memoria Wake blends classic isometric exploration with fast-paced, precision combat.

Perfect your timing and technique to deflect and counter enemy attacks, turning their strength against them with finesse!

Rely on sharp reflexes and quick thinking as you dash, parry, and jab your way through unrelenting nightmares using a diverse arsenal of tools and abilities.

Explore a Fragmented Dream

Traverse hand-crafted dreamscapes where beauty and horror intertwine. Uncover long buried truths, face twisted memories, and piece together the fragments of a broken past.

Unravel a Deep, Emotional Story

Nilo’s journey is personal. The further you push through the world, the closer you get to uncovering the mystery of a long broken bond—but some memories don't want to be found.




Will you chase what can’t be undone? Even fading memories leave a mark. Find them before they’re gone.
